notes.title: Patch 01/11/2023
notes.content:
Hey! 
We've received several emails that owners of modern PC are having issues with the game crashing. We've prepared a small update that should fix this problem. This patch also fixes a few small bugs and improves optimization. 

Happy holidays!

tags.bug: - We've prepared a small update that should fix this problem.
- This patch also fixes a few small bugs

notes.title: Patch December 18 2017
notes.content:
[list]
     [*] Some sounds have been reworked
     [*] Fixed a bug with the ability to turn on the light after starting the game with a checkpoint
     [*] Previously, a sheet in the printer glowed in the dark
     [*] Added sound to the pantry
     [*] Added two events in the kitchen
     [*] Changed position of some objects
     [*] Fixed bug in localization
[/list]

notes.title: Patch December 13 2017
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The design of the start button on the computer has been redone
[*] Additional tips were added to the computer
[*] Corrected the bug associated with the re-raising of the flashlight
[*] Added a hint on the computer that appears after the death of the character
[*] On the street, walls of glitches were replaced with conventional fences to logically not knock down a player
[*] Some triggers have been changed at the level and some key items have been moved to a more appropriate place
[/list]

notes.title: Day one patch
notes.content:
Thanks to all those who support us and help with finding bugs and suggestions for improving the game.

In this patch, bugs related to sounds, light work and gameplay moments were fixed. Also, errors in the English translation have been corrected and management hints added.
